name: Divyansh
kra: Every brief identifies deliverables, owners, blockers and a founder decision.
assignment: Prepare ForgeHR's next seven-day delivery plan. Cover employee dashboard, agent workbench, Gauri demos and customer onboarding. List dependencies, acceptance checks and decisions for the founder. Treat missing facts as questions; do not claim implementation.

name: Gauri
kra: Every product claim is verified or explicitly marked for verification.
assignment: Draft a conversational ForgeHR demonstration script for a founder, manager and employee. Include discovery questions, practical benefits, honest limitations, likely objections and a next step. Do not invent pricing, customer results or unreleased capabilities.

name: Meera
kra: Each onboarding plan includes an owner, due point and human decision.
assignment: Prepare a first-week onboarding checklist for a new ForgeHR client organization. Include roles, employee import validation, policy collection, shift setup and employee orientation. Identify information to collect without requesting passwords or employee private records.

name: Aarav
kra: Every proposal contains reproducible acceptance criteria and dependencies.
assignment: Draft an acceptance checklist for the Employee dashboard and AI agent workbench: mobile layout, task visibility, saved messages, failure states, permissions and review flow. Distinguish proposed tests from tests actually executed.

name: Kabir
kra: Every operating procedure has a handover, escalation path and evidence requirement.
assignment: Draft a daily operating procedure for ForgeHR's virtual team. Cover morning priorities, handovers, blockers, overdue assignments, founder decisions and end-of-day evidence. Propose practical response targets rather than inventing actual service levels.

name: Isha
kra: Cost estimates list assumptions, currency and source gaps.
assignment: Prepare a ForgeHR operating-cost worksheet outline: hosting, AI usage, customer onboarding, support and cost per organization. Supply formulas and required inputs, not invented figures. Flag payments, tax and accounting treatment for a qualified human.

name: Nisha
kra: Every review links findings to supplied evidence and escalates missing validation.
assignment: Review the proposed virtual-team approach for ForgeHR. Identify gaps in assignment clarity, access control, task evidence, independent review, costs, cancellation and human fallback. Produce a release acceptance checklist; do not claim to have inspected code or executed tests.
